status: experimental defensive architecture; no production promotion
purpose: Use diverse defensive agents and deterministic controls as a layered digital immune system for detecting, containing, learning from, and recovering from hostile or contaminating inputs without granting autonomous defensive agents ambient authority.

biological_analogy.barriers: schema validation, sandboxing, deny-egress, content boundaries
biological_analogy.innate_immunity: fast generic detectors for prompt injection, tool poisoning, anomalous behavior, malformed provenance, unexpected capability requests
biological_analogy.adaptive_immunity: learned signatures, recurring attack families, confirmed incident memory, organization-specific threat patterns
biological_analogy.antigen_presentation: normalized threat observations presented to independent reviewers/policy engines
biological_analogy.antibodies: portable signatures, negative fixtures, deny rules, challenge patterns, revocation indicators
biological_analogy.inflammation: temporary risk elevation, step-up verification, narrower budgets, reduced privileges
biological_analogy.quarantine: isolate suspicious content, tool descriptions, artifacts, agents, sessions, or workflows from consequential effect paths
biological_analogy.memory_cells: retained confirmed incident patterns and regression fixtures
biological_analogy.immune_tolerance: avoid treating unfamiliar but benign behavior as malicious solely because it differs from prior patterns

agent_roles.function: Observe inputs, tool metadata, retrieved content, protocol messages, model context, and behavior for suspicious patterns.
Generate adversarial interpretations and test whether suspicious instructions are data, policy, or attempted control.
Inspect source, signature, lineage, freshness, substitution, and context boundaries.
Compare requested actions, destinations, budgets, and causal history against expected policy and prior admitted intent.
Exercise suspicious content or tools in an isolated disposable environment to observe attempted side effects.
Promote confirmed incidents into signatures, regression fixtures, and threat intelligence while preserving provenance and uncertainty.

decision_lanes.description: One or more immune agents flag a concern.
Independent detectors or deterministic evidence agree on a threat hypothesis.
A bounded verifier, reproducible test, or authorized review confirms the incident.

core_invariants: No single model or defensive agent is a root of trust.
Defensive agents produce signals and hypotheses; deterministic policy or separately authorized review controls consequential containment.
Quarantine is scoped, time-bounded where practical, inspectable, and reversible unless independent evidence requires stronger action.
Unknown or novel behavior is not itself proof of hostility.
Threat memory retains provenance, confidence, scope, expiry/review state, and falsification history.
A detector must be replaceable without changing the underlying authority semantics.
Attack intelligence may propagate; authority does not propagate with it.
Content from one trust domain must not silently rewrite system instructions, policy, credentials, or long-term memory.
anti_autoimmunity: detector diversity to reduce correlated false positives
appeal/review path for quarantined principals or artifacts
expiry and reassessment for signatures and reputation-like signals
separation between suspiciousness, guilt, identity, and authority
synthetic benign challenge sets to test overblocking
nonclaims: The term mind virus is treated here as shorthand for propagating malicious or contaminating instructions, narratives, artifacts, or behavioral patterns; it is not a clinical claim.
Agent detectors cannot guarantee prompt-injection detection.
This profile does not authorize autonomous retaliation against external systems.
This profile does not create a universal reputation or blacklist system.
